channel.title: Myra Krusemark — Write-ups
channel.description: Write-ups from my workbench in St. Louis: essays with tools in them, benchmarks, and case studies.

item.title: An agent that grows a self
item.description: Coding agents already remember me. Fathom becomes itself alongside me: why Fathom-lake keeps everything as deltas, how it scores on LongMemEval, and what that test misses.

item.title: Jev ain't all that.
item.description: Jev is great because it’s general. Your project probably needs a few specific decisions. Seven methods, 22 small tests, and local demos you can drive with your voice.

item.title: The watermark you can't see
item.description: How a language model hides a message in its word choices. An interactive explanation, with a tool to try it yourself.
